nodes.label: Subnets (prefixes) — heart of the IPAM
nodes.rationale: Each prefix lives inside a VRF, may link to a site and a VLAN, and contains IP addresses — or child prefixes as a container.

nodes.label: Overlap safety — PostgreSQL GiST exclusion constraint
nodes.rationale: The database enforces no-overlap within a VRF, not app code; container prefixes are exempt so they can hold child subnets, and moving a container takes its children along.

nodes.label: Prefix detail views — subnet matrix + list view + utilization
nodes.rationale: IPv6 prefixes show — for capacity because a /64 exceeds Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, but used_ips stays accurate; network/broadcast excluded from usable counts.

nodes.label: Next-free-IP allocation (SELECT FOR UPDATE + UNIQUE(vrf_id,address))
nodes.rationale: Concurrent allocations can never hand out the same address twice; network/broadcast boundaries are skipped and defined IP ranges are excluded automatically.

nodes.label: IP ranges (dhcp/pool/reserved bands)
nodes.rationale: Named ranges inside a prefix shown as bands in the subnet matrix and skipped by allocation.

nodes.label: Prefix print view
nodes.rationale: Print-friendly page rendering the address list cleanly for audits and wall-of-ops printouts.
